names.note: Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's second heading for the Julian 9 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Преподобни Филором исповедник.“, with both rank words left off — Преподобни and исповедник, which are the two the folder's `types` carry. The heading gives no epithet and no place; Galatia, which this folder's English name carries, is in the body's first sentence. `Филором` is held by no other folder.

floruit.note: The Ohrid Prologue at pravoslavno.rs for the Julian 9 March: „Живео и подвизавао се у Галатији у IV веку.“ It gives the century and no year. The entry also says he reposed in his eightieth year, which is an age and not a date, and it is the only source read for him.

Not checked: doxologia.ro's calendar for 9 martie, which is the page for this menologion number — not 22 martie, which merely shares his civil date in 2026.

Not checked: saint.gr's εορτολόγιο for 9 Μαρτίου, which is the page for this menologion number. The corpus already holds the other two entries of that Greek day, the Forty of Sebaste and `caesarius-brother-of-gregory-the-theologian`, and no page read for them names him.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 22.03.2026 (9. март ст. ст.) — „Преподобни Филором исповедник.“

attestations.note: The day's second entry, five sentences long, and a new folder rather than an upgrade: the name sweep returned only kin matches on Flor- and Philaret-, and a grep of `saints/` for the Latin and Greek stems — philorom, Φιλόρωμ — found nothing at all. The Prologue is the only one of the four calendars read for him.
